% A package or a class of the writer's, beside the document, with the
% name of a tex4ht configuration file: slides.sty, url.sty, or exam.cls.
% Built as it is, the document reads no such file, and the page says so.
% run.mjs builds it again from each folder of test-ownpkg/: the folder's
% files are copied beside the document, and ownpkg-case.tex there loads
% the class and packages and defines \ownpkgbody, the case's text. As in
% the PDF, each case's text is in the page, as the writer's file sets it,
% and tex4ht reads no .4ht for the writer's file, as for any other file
% of the document: a .4ht configures the tree's file, not the writer's.
% The cases with \maketitle and with exam.cls's page style show what
% slides.4ht and exam.4ht change, and a writer's exam.cls with none of the
% macros that exam.4ht tests loses exam.4ht too, as does a writer's
% exam.sty. The guards keep their .4ht: older copies of the tree's url.sty
% and IEEEtran.cls, an edited copy of the tree's tikz-cd.sty, the tree's
% slides class, a writer's class with a .4ht of the writer's beside it,
% and a publisher's aa.cls, which the tree lacks. The tree's slides.sty is
% left out: it loads the slides class, and LaTeX stops with the error
% "Two \LoadClass commands" after article.
\InputIfFileExists{ownpkg-case.tex}{}{%
  \documentclass{article}
  \def\ownpkgbody{No package or class of the writer's.}}
\begin{document}
\ownpkgbody
\end{document}
